item.title: A Note on Chapter 15 of Capital Vol. II
item.description:
SUMMARY

This text, which is a translated excerpt from the Introduction to the Apparat section of volume 13 of the second Abteilung of the Marx and Engels Gesamtausgabe, deals with some of the difficulties that Engels had when editing the section of the volume that dealt with the interaction of multiple capitals in their turnover process

More (pdf, 288 KB): A Note on Chapter 15 of Capital Vol. II"
